chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
May Allah have mercy on the women who wear sirwāl garments.

key_terms.اللَّهُ: Allah, the One asked to grant mercy
key_terms.الْمُسَرْوَلَاتِ: women who wear sirwāl garments; those characterized by such covering
key_terms.رَحِمَ: showed mercy; here, a supplication that Allah bestow mercy

ai.seo_question: What did the Imam عليه السلام say about women who wear sirwāl garments?
ai.summary: The Imam عليه السلام invokes Allah’s mercy upon women described as الْمُسَرْوَلَاتِ. The statement praises modest covering and reflects approval of dignified dress.
